-- Count records that will be loaded
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_records,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN InvoiceNo LIKE 'C%' THEN 1 END) as cancelled_count,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN Quantity < 0 THEN 1 END) as return_count
FROM raw_transactions
WHERE Quantity > 0 
  AND CAST(UnitPrice AS DECIMAL(10,2)) > 0
  AND InvoiceNo IS NOT NULL
  AND StockCode IS NOT NULL

parameters.query:
-- This query does 3 things:
-- 1. Reads clean data from raw_transactions
-- 2. Applies business rules (flags cancelled/returns)
-- 3. Inserts into stg_transactions

INSERT INTO stg_transactions (
  InvoiceNo, 
  StockCode, 
  Description, 
  Quantity, 
  InvoiceDate,
  UnitPrice, 
  CustomerID, 
  Country, 
  TotalAmount,
  is_cancelled, 
  is_return, 
  has_valid_customer, 
  data_quality_flag
)
SELECT 
  -- Clean text fields (remove extra spaces)
  TRIM(InvoiceNo) as InvoiceNo,
  TRIM(StockCode) as StockCode,
  TRIM(Description) as Description,
  
  -- Keep numbers as-is
  Quantity,
  InvoiceDate,
  UnitPrice,
  
  -- Clean optional fields
  TRIM(CustomerID) as CustomerID,
  TRIM(Country) as Country,
  
  -- Calculate total: Quantity × Price
  ROUND(Quantity * UnitPrice, 2) as TotalAmount,
  
  -- Business Rule: Mark cancelled orders (invoice starts with 'C')
  CASE WHEN InvoiceNo LIKE 'C%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_cancelled,
  
  -- Business Rule: Mark returns (negative quantity)
  CASE WHEN Quantity < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_return,
  
  -- Business Rule: Check if customer ID exists
  CASE WHEN CustomerID IS NOT NULL AND CustomerID != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as has_valid_customer,
  
  -- Business Rule: Overall data quality assessment
  CASE 
    WHEN InvoiceNo LIKE 'C%' THEN 'CANCELLED'
    WHEN Quantity < 0 THEN 'RETURN'
    WHEN CustomerID IS NULL OR CustomerID = '' THEN 'NO_CUSTOMER'
    WHEN Description IS NULL OR Description = '' THEN 'NO_DESCRIPTION'
    ELSE 'VALID'
  END as data_quality_flag
  
FROM ecommerce_source.raw_transactions

-- Only include good quality records:
WHERE Quantity > 0                              -- Positive quantities only
  AND CAST(UnitPrice AS DECIMAL(10,2)) > 0      -- Valid prices only
  AND InvoiceNo IS NOT NULL                      -- Must have invoice number
  AND StockCode IS NOT NULL                      -- Must have product code

nodes.name: Load & Transform Data
nodes.notes:
Transforms and loads data in one step:

📥 Reads from: raw_transactions
📤 Writes to: stg_transactions

• Cleans whitespace
• Calculates TotalAmount
• Flags cancelled orders
• Flags returns
• Marks data quality issues
